sampling_model.design: Independent sampling from a fixed observed-data law \(P\) in the \(\eta\)-interior binary product class.
sampling_model.treatment: Both treatment decisions are binary; the target strategy fixes \((A_0,A_1)=(1,1)\).
sampling_model.overlap: The six primitive coordinates \((a,q_0,e_0,e_1,p_0,p_1)\) and their complements are bounded below by \(\eta\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No nonparametric nuisance is fitted; the seven relevant coarsened cell probabilities are estimated by multinomial frequencies, and all empirical endpoints and branch gradients use the explicit seven-cell simplex extensions, with a deterministic fallback when an empirical cell is too small.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Lemma 8 states that the sharp product-model upper bound is equivalently obtained by the normalization-constrained ratio program.
Proposition 3 bounds the sharp product-model upper endpoint by the minimum of two unconstrained optimized values.
Corollary 1 proves exactness of the two Proposition 3 components on two sensitivity-free product-model faces.
Theorem 1 gives sharp cross-sectional marginal-sensitivity bounds through one conditional quantile-balancing constraint.
The paper gives doubly sharp and doubly valid estimation for cross-sectional marginal-sensitivity endpoints.
The paper develops efficient estimators and confidence intervals for bounds under longitudinal MSM sensitivity models.
The ordinary bootstrap generally fails for nonlinear directionally differentiable maps, while derivative-aware resampling can be valid.
Gaussian-multiplier approximation is available for maxima without restrictions on cross-coordinate correlations.
The paper constructs efficient endpoint estimators and simultaneous multiplier bands under an average-case sensitivity model.

body.tldr: In the positive binary two-decision product sensitivity model of Tan (2025), exact compatibility collapses to five success probabilities and yields sharp lower and upper bounds for \(\mu_{11}\) as at most \(64\) rational branches per endpoint. Reversing the two proof chains behind Proposition 3 gives complete observable iff conditions for equality and strictness, including active ties and every sensitivity-free face. Explicit endpoint and branch maps on the seven-cell simplex then support an all-branch Gaussian-multiplier envelope with uniform asymptotic coverage for the complete sharp interval, without selecting an active branch and while allowing redundant branches and singular score covariance.

project_justification.gap: Tan proves that feasible nonnegative product-ratio triples satisfying the normalization and range constraints admit compatible full-data realizations and gives a generic sharp optimization, but the binary endpoint remains implicit. The necessity direction, the binary-cell mean identity, the finite frontier, the complete Proposition 3 equality geometry, and sample inference require separate arguments.
project_justification.niche: Binary intermediate covariates and outcomes retain the longitudinal compatibility problem while making every conditional ratio table exactly reducible to a success probability, which exposes both a finite frontier and the equality geometry of the relaxations.
project_justification.fill: The project proves full-data attainment for a closed-form branch atlas, completes the Proposition 3 equality-versus-strictness classification, defines matching law-indexed and seven-cell-simplex versions of every endpoint and branch, and attaches a uniformly honest multinomial confidence set for the entire identified interval.

body.related_work: Tan (2025) defines the longitudinal product ratios, proves that every feasible nonnegative ratio triple satisfying the stated normalizations and range constraints has a compatible full-data realization, and represents the sharp upper bound by a constrained generalized ICE/IPW program. The present note proves the converse necessity for the binary product model, derives the binary-cell ICE/IPW identity coefficient by coefficient, and then reduces the exact image to a finite frontier; these derivations are not attributed to Tan. Tan also derives two conservative Proposition 3 values with selected exact faces in Corollary 1. The present claims strictly complete that relaxation comparison in the binary model rather than propose a new sensitivity model. Dorn and Guo (2023) show that cross-sectional marginal-sensitivity extrema use normalized threshold weights; their complementary-slackness construction informs the binary threshold reduction, while Tan's sequential product normalizations create the longitudinal coupling. Dorn, Guo, and Kallus (2024) develop sharp and valid cross-sectional estimation but do not address this longitudinal finite frontier. Bonvini et al. (2022) provide efficient estimators and confidence intervals for bounds under different longitudinal MSM sensitivity restrictions. Fang and Santos (2019) explains why an ordinary bootstrap is unreliable for a tied finite minimum or maximum and motivates derivative-aware contact sets. Chernozhukov, Chetverikov, and Kato (2013) supplies Gaussian-multiplier approximation for correlated maxima; the note's proof adds the uniform rational remainder and identified-interval coverage step. Zhang and Zhao (2026) pairs closed-form bounds with multiplier bands under an average-case cross-sectional model, providing a writing and inference exemplar rather than a theorem-level input. Rop et al. (2025) documents the limited use of sensitivity analysis in current time-varying treatment applications. Dickerman et al. (2023) supplies the applied consumer: the absolute six-year cancer risk under a repeated metformin strategy.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The source-fidelity repair cleanly separates imported and derived mathematics: Tan supplies the feasible-triple realization, the generic sharp program, and the generalized ICE/IPW definition, whereas this note proves necessity, the binary-cell identity, the image equality, and endpoint attainment. The result remains confined to positive binary outcomes and intermediate covariates with a degenerate baseline and two treatment decisions. No claim concerns contrasts between treatment strategies, sign breakdown, continuous outcomes, more than two decisions, efficiency, or shortest confidence sets.
body.honest_scope: The proved contribution consists of the finite endpoint representation, full-data attainment, the Proposition 3 equality frontier and strict witness, exact agreement of the law-indexed and seven-cell-simplex maps, the uniform remainder result, and uniform coverage for the entire sharp interval. The contact-set-adaptive improvement remains isolated as an open-ended question. At \(G=B=C=1\), the formulas reduce to the standard g-formula. The empirical consumer is the absolute sustained-strategy risk only.
